cdc: single common DHI domain; no CDC added
reset: common reset cancels reader and ownership; separate core-only cleanup only after safe drain or while LOCK
limitations: Per-camera physical-slot priority is not a per-camera arrival-order FIFO
Capture-sequence uniqueness is an upstream publisher precondition; full descriptor/header identity is checked, no unbounded history is stored
RAW release is an output ready/valid record; source adapter must match it before writer release
